MERGER TRANSITION AGREEMENT

Between Sable Holdings and Tidalwave Energy.

Section 3. Change of Control. A change of control of either party requires the written consent of the other party before closing.

Section 10. Liability. Tidalwave's liability shall be unlimited for environmental claims.

AGREED:

Sable Holdings

Signature: __________

evidence.quote: A change of control of either party requires the written consent of the other party before closing.
Tidalwave's liability shall be unlimited for environmental claims.

expected.rationale: Consent-on-control-change on page 1, unlimited environmental liability on page 2, and a blank signature block on page 2.
